answer: Retries cost 212.2s on claude-sonnet-5 across 7 requests (22 failed attempts). Time is measured to the start of the last attempt (inferred).
sql:
SELECT l.model, count(*) AS retried_requests, sum(l.attempt - 1) AS failed_attempts,
  round(sum((e.last_attempt_ns - l.start_ns)/1e9),1) AS seconds_lost
FROM llm l JOIN (SELECT trace_id, span_id, max(time_ns) AS last_attempt_ns FROM span_events WHERE name='gen_ai.request.attempt' GROUP BY 1,2) e
  USING (trace_id, span_id)
WHERE l.attempt > 1 GROUP BY l.model ORDER BY seconds_lost DESC
